description: The project's sky (list_skies): an HDRI environment that lights the model with realistic reflections and ambient light and can show behind it. id "none" goes back to the default lighting. rotation (degrees) turns it, e.g. to put the sunset behind the building; intensity is the lighting strength (1 = as photographed, 0–5); background false lights the model without showing the sky; blur (0–1) softens the background. Settings you leave out keep their current values. Saved with the project; one undo step. Works alongside set_sun (direct sunlight and shadows).

id.description: Sky id, or "none"; omit to adjust the current sky

name: set_sky
title: Set the sky
